The '''DLT-20A''' (also called a '''"longblaster"''' or '''"longbarrel"''') was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] sometime before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:Dlt20A.jpg|thumb|left|200px|DLT-20A schematics]]

The BlasTech DLT-20A blaster rifle was a long-barreled [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] (sometimes referred to as a "[[Longblaster/Legends|longblaster]]") with a top-mounted rangefinder and electronic sight. It had automatic and semiautomatic settings and a rate of fire very close to that of the [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] and other longblasters. This was one of the few [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] models produced with a [[Gription|magnatomic adhesion]] grip, keeping the weapon firmly in the wielder's grip and making them more difficult to disarm.<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> With additional collimating rings and longer conduits of [[Galven coil|galven circuitry]], these rifles have improved consistency in their shots.<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary" />

The DLT-20A required a [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]], which could hold 30 shots. The weapon cost 1,300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase, but its sale and use was restricted to legitimate military organizations and police forces.<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide" />

The DLT-20A was similar in design to the BlasTech [[A295 blaster rifle/Legends|A295 blaster rifle]] and the [[E-17d sniper rifle/Legends|E-17d sniper rifle]] favored by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. From the design of the DLT-20A came the [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifle]].

==History==
[[File:DLT20A-CotF.jpg|thumb|[[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]] armed with a DLT-20A blaster rifle]]
The DLT-20A was primarily used by mounted troops, especially [[Republic recon patrol]]s that used local planetary [[:Category:Creatures|wildlife]] as their mounts.<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide" /> They favored this rifle since the ability to hit a foe at a great distance was highly valued in their reconnaissance missions.<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide" />

This weapon was later commonly used by the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when other standard-issue blasters proved to lack long-range accuracy. The notorious [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]] was also known to use this weapon. Because of its high precision, the DLT-20A was often a prized weapon on the black market.<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary" />

==Behind the scenes==
Like many weapons seen in the [[original trilogy]], this weapon appears to be cobbled together from parts of various real-world firearms, such as the action and trigger housing from a late World War II German [[Wikipedia:StG44|StG44]] assault rifle, with the perforated barrel sleeve from a [[Wikipedia:Browning_M1919|Browning M1919]] machine gun attached. The shoulder stock appears to have been custom-made by the [[Industrial Light & Magic]] prop department. While consisting of different parts, the gun is configured closely to the [[Wikipedia:FG_42|FG42]] [[Wikipedia: German_Wehramacht|German Wehrmacht]] paratrooper automatic rifle, again from the World War II era.

A Hasbro [https://www.rebelscum.com/VTSCIG88.asp IG-88] action figure (#87309, 2007) carries a DLT-20A. The Hasbro ''Battlefront'' [https://www.rebelscum.com/OTCSWbattlefrontscout.asp Scout Trooper] action figure (#85388, 2004), issued to commemorate the release of [[Star Wars: Battlefront|the video game]], is also equipped with a DLT-20A, but in the game he carries an [[E-11s sniper rifle/Legends|E-11s sniper rifle]], which resembles a DLT-19 with scope added.

The [[DC-15x sniper rifle/Legends|DC-15x sniper rifle]] looks similar to these DLT weapons.
